videos.title: Canada's Anand Eyes Progress on US Trade Talks
videos.description: Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand discusses conversations with Secretary of State Marco Rubio and the outlook for trade negotiations between the nations following the Democrats upending of the US political landscape in last week's midterm elections. "Canada very much hopes that will have progress on the trade front," Anand says, speaking to Bloomberg from Paris. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
